q: 1. What was the budget allocation for Nepal's First Five-Year Plan?
explain: The total budget allocated for the First Five-Year Plan (2013-2018 BS) was 33 Crore NPR.

q: 2. Which country was the first to propose the concept of trade liberalization (SAPTA) at the Colombo Summit in 1991?
explain: Sri Lanka first mooted trade liberalization at the 6th Summit in Colombo in December 1991. India, Nepal, and Bangladesh were co-signatories to SAPTA but not the original proposers.

q: 3. The first Earth summit was held at -----------
explain: The United Nations Conference on Environment and Development (UNCED), also known as the Earth Summit, was held in Rio de Janeiro in 1992.

q: 4. --------, came out as a part of Earth Summit 1992.
explain: Agenda 21 is a comprehensive plan of action to be taken globally, nationally, and locally by organizations of the UN, which was a major outcome of the 1992 Earth Summit.
The answer key specifies 'Our Power, Our Planet' as the theme for Earth Day 2025.

q: 6. Which one agenda is not related with Earth Summit, 1992 AD?
explain: Global 500 was an award program started in 1987 by UNEP, whereas the others were formal outcomes or topics of the 1992 Summit.

q: 7. The Goldman award is related to;
explain: The Goldman Environmental Prize is awarded annually to grassroots environmental activists.

q: 8. In which year were all tasks related to the development budget and foreign aid reassigned from the Ministry of Economic Planning to the ministry of finance?
explain: In 1968 (2025 BS), administrative restructuring led to the transfer of budgeting and aid management functions to the Ministry of Finance.

q: 9. At which Summit was the tenure of the Secretary-General formally extended from 2 to 3 years?
explain: The Ninth Summit in Male, Maldives (1997) formally approved extending the tenure to three years. The other options are incorrect.

q:
10. Which of the following Statement(s) about famous Scientist Albert Einstein is/are correct? 
 1. He was born in France 
 2. He received Nobel Prize in 1921 A.D. 
 3. He was died in U.S.A.
explain: Einstein was born in Germany (not France), won the Nobel Prize in 1921 for his work on the photoelectric effect, and died in Princeton, USA.

q: 11. Who is the current chairman of Twitter, the famous social network?
explain: Elon Musk acquired Twitter in 2022 and took over leadership (later rebranding it to X).

q: 12. During the 18th SAARC Summit, which theme has been agreed by all eight member countries by engaging in formal agreement?
explain: At the 18th Summit in Kathmandu, all eight members signed the SAARC Framework Agreement on Energy Cooperation (Electricity).
